mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_reminder (user_id, reminder_type, content, status, scheduled_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reminderType}, #{content}, #{status}, #{scheduledTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, reminder_type, content, status, scheduled_time, create_time FROM health_reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY scheduled_time ASC
SELECT id, user_id, reminder_type, content, status, scheduled_time, create_time FROM health_reminder WHERE status = 0 AND scheduled_time <= #{now} ORDER BY scheduled_time ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM health_reminder WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysAgo} DAY)
